review.finding: The empty-body check uses the same per-line runs_interpreter flag as the unterminated check, so every heredoc opened on a line that also runs `python -` is blamed on the interpreter (e.g. `python - < script.py && cat > out.txt <<'E'` + `E`). Rare; failing this way only blocks a command.
review.suggestion: Accept as a documented known miss, or attribute each heredoc to its own segment. At minimum pin the behaviour with a test.
